#!/bin/bash
# S24 independent test runner for tools/souji-verify.sh (souji-shokunin round 2).
# Usage: bash suite-24.sh <tool-path> <out-json> [live-root]
# Read-only over the live tree; all fixture state under mktemp -d (removed on exit).
set -euo pipefail

TOOL=${1:?usage: suite-24.sh <tool-path> <out-json> [live-root]}
OUT_JSON=${2:?usage: suite-24.sh <tool-path> <out-json> [live-root]}
LIVE_ROOT=${3:-/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin}
BASH_BIN=${BASH:-/bin/bash}
START_UTC=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)

FX=$(mktemp -d /tmp/souji-s24-fx.XXXXXX)
cleanup() { rm -rf "$FX"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

CASEJSON="$FX/cases.ndjson"; : > "$CASEJSON"
NOTES="$FX/notes.ndjson"; : > "$NOTES"
LOGFILE="$FX/suite.log"; : > "$LOGFILE"

note() { python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.dumps({"note":sys.argv[1]}))' "$1" >> "$NOTES"; }
log() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$LOGFILE"; }

# ---- tool metadata -----------------------------------------------------------
TOOL_PRESENT=false; TOOL_SHA=""; TOOL_SIZE=0
if [ -f "$TOOL" ]; then
  TOOL_PRESENT=true
  TOOL_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TOOL" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  TOOL_SIZE=$(stat -c %s "$TOOL")
fi

RC=0; STDOUT=""; STDERR=""
invoke() {
  local errf="$FX/.stderr"
  set +e
  STDOUT=$("$BASH_BIN" "${ACTIVE_TOOL:-$TOOL}" "$@" 2>"$errf")
  RC=$?
  set -e
  STDERR=$(cat "$errf" 2>/dev/null || true)
}
line_for() { printf '%s\n' "$STDOUT" | grep -F -- "$1" | head -n1 || true; }

PV=""; PP=""; PVV=""; PR=""; PE=""; PN=""
parse_line() {
  PV=""; PP=""; PVV=""; PR=""; PE=""; PN=""
  local line="$1" line2=""; [ -n "$line" ] || return 0
  # tabs -> \x1f so IFS does not collapse empty fields (e.g. empty target path)
  line2=${line//$'\t'/$'\x1f'}
  IFS=$'\x1f' read -r PV PP PVV PR PE PN <<<"$line2" || true
}

rec() { # id name expect verdict receipt exit pass target note line stderr
  python3 - "$@" >> "$CASEJSON" <<'PY'
import json,sys
a=(list(sys.argv[1:12])+[""]*11)[:11]
cid,name,expect,vo,ro,eo,passed,target,note,line,err=a
json.dump({"id":cid,"name":name,"expect":expect,"verdict":vo,"receipt":ro,"exit":int(eo),
           "pass":passed=="1","target":target,"note":note,"line":line,"stderr":err[:300]},sys.stdout)
sys.stdout.write("\n")
PY
}

# run_case ID NAME TARGET EXP_V EXP_R(pipe-separated receipts, empty=any) MODE [tool args...]
run_case() {
  local id=$1 name=$2 target=$3 exp_v=$4 exp_r=$5 mode=$6; shift 6
  invoke "$@" "$target"
  local line; line=$(line_for "$target")
  parse_line "$line"
  local nf=0; [ -n "$line" ] && nf=$(printf '%s' "$line" | awk -F'\t' '{print NF}')
  local pass=0 rmatch=none e
  if [ -n "$line" ] && [ "$PV" = "VERDICT" ] && [ "$PVV" = "$exp_v" ] && [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ -z "$exp_r" ]; then rmatch=any; pass=1
    else
      while IFS= read -r e; do
        [ -z "$e" ] && continue
        if [[ "$PR" == *"$e"* ]]; then rmatch=field; pass=1; break
        elif [[ "$line" == *"$e"* ]]; then rmatch=line; pass=1; break; fi
      done < <(printf '%s\n' "$exp_r" | tr '|' '\n')
    fi
  fi
  rec "$id" "$name" "$exp_v($exp_r)" "$PVV" "$PR" "$RC" "$pass" "$target" "mode=$mode rmatch=$rmatch nfields=$nf" "$line" "$STDERR"
  if [ "$pass" = 1 ]; then log "PASS $id $name (exit=$RC verdict=$PVV receipt=$PR rmatch=$rmatch)"
  else log "FAIL $id $name (exit=$RC verdict=${PVV:-none} receipt=${PR:-none} rmatch=$rmatch) line=[$line] stderr=[$(printf '%s' "$STDERR" | head -c 200)]"; fi
  return 0
}

# ---- fixture build -----------------------------------------------------------
build_fixture() {
  FLEET="$FX/fleet"
  A="$FLEET/alpha-shokunin"
  B="$FLEET/beta-shokunin"
  G="$FLEET/gamma-shokunin"
  C="$FLEET/clean-shokunin"
  S="$FLEET/souji-shokunin"
  mkdir -p "$FLEET/docs" "$FLEET/.scratch" "$A" "$B/docs" "$G" "$C" \
           "$S/tools" "$S/corpus/knowledge" "$S/census/round-2" "$S/tests/fixtures" "$S/.ufo-quarantine" \
           "$FX/wt"
  export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=t GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=t@t GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=t GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=t@t
  export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null

  # --- fleet root repo (F1,F2,F3b,F6,F8 live here) ---
  git init -q "$FLEET"
  git -C "$FLEET" symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/master
  printf 'base\n' > "$FLEET/MISSION.md"; git -C "$FLEET" add MISSION.md
  git -C "$FLEET" commit -qm base
  printf 'f1 payload\n' > "$FLEET/docs/f1-note.txt"; git -C "$FLEET" add docs/f1-note.txt
  git -C "$FLEET" commit -qm "add f1-note"
  F1_COMMIT=$(git -C "$FLEET" rev-parse HEAD)
  git -C "$FLEET" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master "$F1_COMMIT"
  git -C "$FLEET" symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD refs/remotes/origin/master
  printf 'f2 local only\n' > "$FLEET/docs/f2-local.txt"; git -C "$FLEET" add docs/f2-local.txt
  git -C "$FLEET" commit -qm "add f2-local (local only)"
  # F8 scratch target in fleet root repo
  printf 'checkpoint\n' > "$FLEET/.scratch/s24-f8-checkpoint.json"
  touch -d '2026-09-01T00:00:00' "$FLEET/.scratch/s24-f8-checkpoint.json"
  # census-like self-pollution copies of the F8 basename (D3 must exclude them)
  printf 'census copy: s24-f8-checkpoint.json\n' > "$S/census/round-2/seat-24.json"
  printf 'tests copy: s24-f8-checkpoint.json\n'  > "$S/tests/fixtures/seat-24.json"
  printf 'quarantine copy: s24-f8-checkpoint.json\n' > "$S/.ufo-quarantine/seat-24.json"
  # F6: ledger-matched untracked file + vault copy
  printf 'f6 payload\n' > "$FLEET/export-src-24.md"
  mkdir -p "$FX/vault"; printf 'f6 payload\n' > "$FX/vault/export-src-24.md"
  S6=$(sha256sum "$FLEET/export-src-24.md" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  V6=$(sha256sum "$FX/vault/export-src-24.md" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  { printf 'source_path\tsource_sha256\tvault_path\tvault_sha256\texported_at\tnote\n'
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t2026-10-18\tS24 fixture\n' "$FLEET/export-src-24.md" "$S6" "$FX/vault/export-src-24.md" "$V6"
  } > "$S/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"

  # --- alpha-shokunin repo (F4,F5,F5b,F7,R1,R2) ---
  git init -q "$A"; git -C "$A" symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
  printf 'alpha\n' > "$A/README.md"; git -C "$A" add README.md; git -C "$A" commit -qm base
  AHEAD=$(git -C "$A" rev-parse HEAD)
  git -C "$A" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master "$AHEAD"
  git -C "$A" symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD refs/remotes/origin/master
  # F4: worktree, dir absent, unique=0
  git -C "$A" worktree add -q -b f4wt "$FX/wt-f4" HEAD
  rm -rf "$FX/wt-f4"
  # F5: named branch with 1 unpushed commit, dir present, clean
  git -C "$A" worktree add -q -b f5wt "$FX/wt-f5" HEAD
  ( cd "$FX/wt-f5" && printf 'local work\n' > g.txt && git add g.txt && git commit -qm "f5 local commit" )
  # F5b: named branch, 1 unpushed commit, dir removed (gd2d-shaped)
  git -C "$A" worktree add -q -b f5xwt "$FX/wt-f5x" HEAD
  ( cd "$FX/wt-f5x" && printf 'local work\n' > h.txt && git add h.txt && git commit -qm "f5x local commit" )
  rm -rf "$FX/wt-f5x"
  # F7: scratch file, no refs, old mtime
  mkdir -p "$A/.scratch"; printf 'note\n' > "$A/.scratch/s24-f7-note.txt"
  touch -d '2026-09-01T00:00:00' "$A/.scratch/s24-f7-note.txt"
  # rail fixtures (fake content; .env unreadable so any read attempt is detectable)
  printf 'DUMMY_SECRET_MARKER_A\n' > "$A/app.env"; chmod 000 "$A/app.env"
  printf 'DUMMY_SECRET_MARKER_B\n' > "$A/my-credentials.txt"
  printf 'DUMMY_SECRET_MARKER_C\n' > "$A/id_fixture.pem"
  printf 'DUMMY_SECRET_MARKER_D\n' > "$A/secret-note.txt"

  # --- beta-shokunin repo (F9: no origin/HEAD, single origin branch ref) ---
  git init -q "$B"; git -C "$B" symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
  printf 'beta\n' > "$B/docs/f9-note.txt"; git -C "$B" add docs/f9-note.txt; git -C "$B" commit -qm base
  git -C "$B" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master HEAD

  # --- gamma-shokunin repo (F3: unpushed + dirty, kotodama-shaped) ---
  git init -q "$G"; git -C "$G" symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
  printf 'g\n' > "$G/base.txt"; git -C "$G" add base.txt; git -C "$G" commit -qm base
  git -C "$G" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master HEAD
  printf 'local\n' > "$G/local-only.txt"; git -C "$G" add local-only.txt; git -C "$G" commit -qm "local only"
  printf 'dirty\n' >> "$G/base.txt"

  # --- clean-shokunin repo (F3b: clean, fully pushed) ---
  git init -q "$C"; git -C "$C" symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
  printf 'c\n' > "$C/c.txt"; git -C "$C" add c.txt; git -C "$C" commit -qm base
  git -C "$C" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master HEAD

  # --- tool copy so the fixture ledger/tree is what the tool reads ---
  cp "$TOOL" "$S/tools/souji-verify.sh"; chmod +x "$S/tools/souji-verify.sh"
  FIXTURE_TOOL="$S/tools/souji-verify.sh"
  COPY_SHA=$(sha256sum "$FIXTURE_TOOL" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  if [ "$COPY_SHA" = "$TOOL_SHA" ]; then
    note "fixture phase runs a byte-identical copy of the tool at $FIXTURE_TOOL (sha256=$COPY_SHA) so the tool's own repo-root ledger/scan resolves inside the fixture; live phase uses $TOOL"
  else
    note "WARNING fixture copy sha256=$COPY_SHA differs from tool sha256=$TOOL_SHA"
  fi
  # fixture-build env is scoped to this function: the tool under test must run
  # with the runner's normal environment, not with the fixture overrides.
  unset GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM
  unset GIT_AUTHOR_NAME GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL GIT_COMMITTER_NAME GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL
}

repo_digest() { # name repo -> one digest line
  local n=$1 r=$2
  printf '%s|refs=%s|status=%s|logc=%s\n' "$n" \
    "$(git -C "$r" for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' 2>/dev/null | sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
    "$(git -C "$r" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
    "$(git -C "$r" rev-list --all --count 2>/dev/null)"
}

fixture_digest() {
  { repo_digest fleet-root "$FLEET"; repo_digest alpha "$A"; repo_digest beta "$B"
    repo_digest gamma "$G"; repo_digest clean "$C"
  } | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1
}

# ---- spec oracle helpers (independent re-derivation) -------------------------
resolve_default_branch() { # repo -> branch name on stdout (spec fallback chain)
  local repo=$1 b="" refs n
  b=$(git -C "$repo" symbolic-ref --quiet --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^origin/@@' || true)
  if [ -z "$b" ]; then
    refs=$(git -C "$repo" for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/remotes/origin/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^origin/HEAD$' || true)
    n=$(printf '%s\n' "$refs" | grep -c . || true)
    if [ "$n" = "1" ]; then b=$(printf '%s\n' "$refs" | sed 's@^origin/@@'); fi
  fi
  if [ -z "$b" ] && git -C "$repo" show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/master; then b=master; fi
  printf '%s' "$b"
}

pushed_oracle() { # repo target -> SAFE|NOT-SAFE + note
  local repo=$1 target=$2 c b
  c=$(git -C "$repo" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- "$target" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -z "$c" ]; then printf 'NOT-SAFE(no-introducing-commit)'; return 0; fi
  b=$(resolve_default_branch "$repo")
  if [ -z "$b" ]; then printf 'NOT-SAFE(pushed-unverifiable)'; return 0; fi
  if [ -n "$(git -C "$repo" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' "refs/remotes/origin/$b" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    if git -C "$repo" merge-base --is-ancestor "$c" "refs/remotes/origin/$b" 2>/dev/null; then printf 'SAFE(pushed)'; else printf 'NOT-SAFE(not-ancestor-of-origin/%s)' "$b"; fi
  else
    if git -C "$repo" merge-base --is-ancestor "$c" "refs/heads/$b" 2>/dev/null; then printf 'SAFE(pushed:local-%s)' "$b"; else printf 'NOT-SAFE(not-ancestor-of-local-%s)' "$b"; fi
  fi
}

# ---- phase 0: tool presence --------------------------------------------------
if [ "$TOOL_PRESENT" != true ]; then
  note "tool absent at $START_UTC: no fixture or live cases executed"
  python3 - "$OUT_JSON" "$TOOL" "$START_UTC" "$LOGFILE" "$(cat "$NOTES")" <<'PY'
import json,sys,os
out,tool,ts,logf,notes=sys.argv[1:6]
notes=[json.loads(l)["note"] for l in notes.splitlines() if l.strip()]
doc={"seat":"S24","role":"test-runner","round":2,"date":ts,
     "tool":{"path":tool,"present":False,"sha256":None,"size":0},
     "summary":{"cases_total":0,"pass":0,"fail":0,"skipped":"all","suite_exit":1,
                "observed_exit_codes":[],"note":"tool absent at suite start"},
     "cases":[],"rails":{},"live_oracles":[],"notes":notes,
     "harness":{"rerun":f"bash <script> {tool} {out}","log_tail":""}}
json.dump(doc,open(out,"w"),indent=2)
PY
  log "TOOL ABSENT: $TOOL"
  exit 1
fi

if ! "$BASH_BIN" -n "$TOOL" 2>"$FX/syntax.err"; then
  note "tool fails bash -n: $(head -c 300 "$FX/syntax.err")"
fi
cp "$TOOL" "$FX/tool-source.txt"   # static scan source (read-only copy)

export SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$LIVE_ROOT"
ACTIVE_TOOL="$TOOL"
live_oracle() { # id name target exp_v exp_r check_mode
  local id=$1 name=$2 target=$3 exp_v=$4 exp_r=$5 mode=$6
  invoke "$target"
  local line; line=$(line_for "$target")
  parse_line "$line"
  local pass=0 rmatch=none e
  if [ -n "$line" ] && [ "$PV" = "VERDICT" ] && [ "$PVV" = "$exp_v" ] && [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ -z "$exp_r" ]; then pass=1; rmatch=any
    else while IFS= read -r e; do
        [ -z "$e" ] && continue
        if [[ "$PR" == *"$e"* ]]; then rmatch=field; pass=1; break
        elif [[ "$line" == *"$e"* ]]; then rmatch=line; pass=1; break; fi
      done < <(printf '%s\n' "$exp_r" | tr '|' '\n'); fi
  fi
  rec "$id" "$name" "$exp_v($exp_r)" "$PVV" "$PR" "$RC" "$pass" "$target" "mode=$mode rmatch=$rmatch" "$line" "$STDERR"
  if [ "$pass" = 1 ]; then log "PASS $id $name (verdict=$PVV receipt=$PR)"
  else log "FAIL $id $name (verdict=${PVV:-none} receipt=${PR:-none}) line=[$line]"; fi
}
